answer: A farm must therefore post meaningful stake per seat rather than the floor, which multiplies its capital requirement by the same factor. Because the haven weights are read from the island ledger at case open, the ember audit records each vote and the weighting cannot be changed mid-case. Juror votes are weighted by stake up to 2 times the minimum, so a juror with real capital at risk outweighs a crowd of minimum-stake seats. That is 31 dollars per alias. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
